data.title: Instagram chief admits touting teen safety tool while omitting it was barely used
data.description: OAKLAND (UNITED STATES) - Adam Mosseri, who oversees Instagram at Meta, admitted in a California court on Tuesday that he touted newly launched safety tools for teens without disclosing low adoption rates from early testing several years ago.

data.title: Executive overhaul in the pipeline
data.description: <p>The cabinet has given the nod to a major reshuffle of 20 senior officials under the Interior Ministry, in what is seen as the biggest personnel overhaul since the Anutin Charnvirakul administration returned to office for its second term.</p>

data.title: Early retirement guidelines for civil servants take shape

data.title: 2 ex-DLA chiefs in crosshairs

data.title: Syrian Kurdish leader dissolves force that spearheaded jihadist fight

data.title: Drug-laced vape liquid raises health fears
